props.name: entity_type
props.meaning: Type the field list is read on.

props.name: context
props.meaning: The widget context. Every read goes through it, so widgets on a page share one cache.

props.name: value
props.meaning: The keys, in order. Two-way in Svelte through `bind:value`.

props.name: hide_paths
props.meaning: Paths kept out of the field list. A pattern hides itself and everything under it.

props.name: paths
props.meaning: Only these paths are offered in the nested list. A link stays in the list while an offered path runs through it.

props.name: options
props.meaning: Exactly these paths, offered as one flat list, so a table's toolbar sorts on the columns it shows, a linked one included. Takes the place of `paths`.

props.name: open
props.meaning: Whether the popover is showing. Two-way in Svelte.

events.name: changed
events.when: The keys and the `sort` string changed, on every edit. Svelte also binds it with `bind:value`.

events.name: open_changed
events.when: The popover opened or closed. Svelte also binds it with `bind:open`.

keyboard.does: Opens the list, and toggles a direction or a move control inside it.
Moves through each key's grip, direction, move and remove controls, then to the field search.
Move the cursor in the field list, and between ascending and descending.
Descends into the highlighted link in the field picker.
Goes back one level in the field picker.
Picks the key up for the arrow keys.
Put it back where it was.
Move the key holding focus one place.
